No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported.

All inline comments (apple 'Full-bleed: no rx', maskable safe-zone/transform explanation, '// standard') and the 'Pure function — byte-identical output' docblock preserved (doc 'browser doesn't churn the favicon' generalised to 'host doesn't churn the favicon / brand mark').

L107-127 svgToDataUrl(svg) — browser-only `btoa` seam (contract rule 7). Web's `if (typeof btoa !== 'function') return 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,'` empty-string degradation is replaced by a native-safe path: getBtoa() feature-detects the host btoa via the established (globalThis as typeof globalThis & {btoa?: unknown}).btoa cast (mirrors useLogStream getFetch/getTextDecoder) and falls back to encodeBase64Ascii — a pure-TS canonical Latin-1 base64 encoder (standard A-Za-z0-9+/ alphabet, 3-byte grouping, '=' padding) that emits byte-identical output to btoa() for the ASCII SVGs this module produces. So browser/jsdom/react-native-web still use btoa (identical to web) and pure RN now returns a valid byte-stable data URL instead of an empty one. The Latin-1/ASCII-safety and 'switch to TextEncoder if interpolating user text' comments are preserved.

L129-164 renderSvgToPngDataUrl(svg, size) — browser-only document/<canvas>/Image seam (contract rule 7). Behavior preserved on react-native-web via getBrowserDocument()/getImageConstructor() globalThis feature-detection (narrow HTMLCanvasElementLike/CanvasRenderingContext2DLike/HTMLImageElementLike/ImageConstructorLike/DocumentLike interfaces, no `any`, no DOM lib import): identical createElement('canvas') + width/height=size + getContext('2d') null-guard + new Image() onload drawImage(img,0,0,size,size)+toDataURL('image/png') in try/catch + onerror -> null + img.src=svgToDataUrl(svg). On pure React Native (no document/Image) it resolves null — the same Promise<string|null> 'skip this layer' contract the web function documents — with the explicit unavailable state exported as APP_ICON_PNG_UNAVAILABLE_REASON (mirrors LOG_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE_REASON / LEAFLET_GLOBAL_UNAVAILABLE_REASON precedent). Source has no i18n or unit-conversion. Verified from apps/native: npm run typecheck, npm run lint -- --quiet, and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles all pass.
